reason: Wasted trips and a 21-day restart after rejection are real to me [V]. Hearing the checklist in Kannada before I travel helps, even if the counter check gets skipped.
weakest_assumption: That documents cause most rejections; if field verification or eligibility causes most, my trip still gets wasted.
missing_info: How many rejections are document-caused, and whether busy operators actually run the check.

fix.change: Lead with the missed-call Kannada checklist plus a family SMS; make the counter check add-on and say exactly which document to fix.

reason: A missed call with a Kannada voice checklist and an operator reading a Kannada sentence aloud mean I need no app, no typing and no English. A rejection really does cost me 21 days [V].
weakest_assumption: That a busy operator will actually run an optional check and explain the flag to me patiently.
missing_info: Not tested with elderly callers or operators. Is the voice menu usable without pressing keypad digits?

fix.change: Test the missed-call voice flow and operator read-aloud with five elderly Kannada speakers on keypad phones. Make spoken-answer input work, not only keypad menus.

reason: It reuses my existing scans and never blocks me, but it is still an extra drag-and-review step at the counter. Willingness, the 30 s speed and failure behaviour are all untested.
weakest_assumption: A busy operator will run an optional, non-binding check on every applicant during a rush.
missing_info: Timed counter trial: real taps, seconds per applicant, behaviour when the scan or check fails mid-shift.

fix.change: Auto-run the check on the scan folder the operator already saves to, so there is no drag step; if it fails, fall back to a printed checklist.

reason: Verified: rejections force full reapplication and 21-day waits; unreadable/mismatch/incomplete statuses exist. Advisory check uses existing scans, operator decides. But adds a step, untested.
weakest_assumption: Busy operators will actually drag scans into a separate tool outside the portal for every application.
missing_info: Share of rejections caused by documents; timed operator trial at a real counter.

fix.change: Log each check's flags and the operator's decision so accountability stays with the operator; time ten real counter runs to prove under 30 seconds.

reason: Missed-call checklist and pre-check address upstream causes of document rejections: not knowing what to bring and poor scans. The no-revival rule [V] persists, and document share is [?].
weakest_assumption: Document errors, not eligibility or field verification, cause most rejections.
missing_info: Breakdown of rejection reasons from operators or Seva Sindhu rejection logs.

fix.change: Interview 5 CSC operators and tally their last 20 rejections by reason, to confirm document causes dominate before building further.

reason: One journey fits in 22h: a hand-entered income checklist plus a counter check on seeded scans is doable. Rejection cost [V] is real; telephony and Kannada OCR are the demo risks.
weakest_assumption: OCR and name matching on real Kannada and English scans work reliably in under 30 seconds
missing_info: Real sample scans; whether a telephony and SMS provider account is ready
